source_policy: Always re-fetch each selected skill, schema and file from current main and verify its live blob/content SHA before applying; this index is navigational, not a second protocol.

technical.purpose: 12-section factual technical explanation, after independently authenticated Stage-1 freeze
technical.scope: Stage2-after-freeze only; never disclose unreleased predecessor implementation to a blind agent
technical.owner: Native PLAN_HANDOVER/HANDOVER_CONTEXT; template has no transaction/write authority

two_standalone.purpose: Exactly two prompts: blind independent system baseline, then improve/reconcile/plan
two_standalone.scope: V3.1 standalone generator; Pass 1 cannot receive task, PR, solution or implementation details

three_standalone.scope: Independent imagination/reality/reconciliation process; no stage grafting

v36.purpose: Native O1–O5 lifecycle, cold successor and governed project-specific 2-/3-pass prompts
v36.scope: Requires exact Owner-approved label/plan/issue and writable lab if needed; dry-run unless explicit scoped write authorization

buddy17.purpose: 1a→1b→2 and one Xb→Y; v1.7 additionally verifies successor and peer role assumptions
buddy17.scope: Use only when explicitly selected or named by governing project; no automatically invoked next stage

buddy16.purpose: Pinned 1a→1b→2 or Xb→Y continuity on governing projects still using v1.6
buddy16.scope: Do not silently upgrade an explicitly pinned v1.6 workflow to v1.7

onb.purpose: Zero-exit twelve-section source-referenced report, manifest and fail-closed verdict
onb.scope: WP5 merged to main; WP1a–WP4 drafts #392–#396 NOT installed on main; RWI NOT_EVALUATED/Owner BLOCKED until proofs

v35_legacy.purpose: Historical v3.5 native handover and continuity projection
v35_legacy.scope: Legacy/read-only by default. Not a v3.6 dependency or chosen for new v3.6 work

observer.purpose: Read-only observe/check status, not start a BuddyRunner or handover phase
observer.scope: No scheduler, Owner approval, data mutation or phase advancement

mcda.purpose: Optional established MCDA evaluation after actual evidence and Owner-approved weights
mcda.scope: Never use as a substitute for eligibility/Owner intent gate or demand novelty
